subject: First-time-right release acceleration live
implemented: Zero-dependency inline JavaScript syntax preflight before preview, build and Playwright/browser execution
Malformed shared/page inline JavaScript fails early before expensive CI starts
Regression contracts cover unterminated inline JavaScript and release ordering
Website regression tests are classified into the website delivery lane
Required test status bridge removed because it consumed a runner while polling the Required test it was waiting for
Protected test gate retained; browser, visibility, SEO, desktop/mobile and high-risk coverage retained
verified: Required gate green on exact PR head before merge
Netlify production deploy is ready on the same SHA
permanent_release_invariant: Prevent cheap failures before expensive CI. Never weaken branch protection or runtime/browser gates to gain speed. Shared-shell and JavaScript changes must fail fast on syntax and then pass impact-aware browser validation before release.

open_follow_up.reason: Multiple standalone pull_request workflows still create runner fan-out and queue latency around Required test.
open_follow_up.required_outcome: Move duplicate PR ingress coverage behind the canonical Required test control plane while preserving all effective coverage and branch protection.
